The bookmaker's notably depressed draw probability (0.143) stands apart from the tighter clustering of other estimates (0.172-0.209). The confirmed lineup and absence of contradictory signals support this direction, making away the clear recommendation despite moderate uncertainty from missing draw modeling and incomplete source coverage.
